title: Progressive state reveal for buttons and theme-aware microcopy
creator: Rina Sato
description: Problem: Several product teams reported inconsistent behavior and unclear wording across primary/secondary/icon buttons when transitioning into transient states (loading, disabled, confirmation). We observed: 1) spinners and skeletons competing for space, 2) icon-only destructive controls lacking a clear hold/confirmation affordance, 3) theme-dependent text that becomes illegible in dark/high-contrast themes, and 4) token drift after the recent color token migration. Goal: Define a predictable progressive reveal pattern for button states and introduce theme-aware microcopy rules so labels and affordances remain clear across themes and reduced-motion settings. Scope: primary/secondary/ghost/tertiary and icon-only variants; loading, disabled, pending-confirmation states; token mapping notes for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Designs for all button variants include a clear progressive reveal sequence: initial idle -> soft disabled (visual hint) -> loading (inline spinner or progress indicator) -> final disabled or success state
Icon-only destructive buttons implement a hold-to-confirm pattern with persistent accessible label and visual countdown that respects prefers-reduced-motion
Microcopy guidelines produced: concise theme-aware strings for temporary states (e.g., "Saving…" not "Please wait") and rules for truncation and localization
Color token references updated and verified against runtime-1.18 token set; no contrast regressions in dark or high-contrast themes
Engineering sign-off on animation timing, token variables used, and fallback spacing for spinner vs label collisions
Automated visual regression tests added for the new patterns and linked to PR
engineering_notes: Prefer inline spinner token --spinner-size-sm inside button when label present; use spinner-only 20px for icon buttons
Expose CSS variables for state threshold: --button-soft-disabled-opacity and --button-loading-gap to avoid layout shift
Provide data-state attributes: data-state="idle|soft-disabled|loading|confirming|disabled" for tracing and QA
Fallback behavior: if label width < spinner width + padding, show compact spinner overlaid with aria-hidden=true and update accessible label to indicate progress
Performance: avoid synchronous layout thrash when toggling spinner; batch class updates where possible
qa_checks: Verify contrast ratios for token combinations in light/dark/high-contrast themes (WCAG AA/AAA where applicable)
Test hold-to-confirm on keyboard (Space/Enter) and pointer; ensure 200ms debounce and visible countdown
Simulate slow network to confirm progressive reveal timing looks natural and doesn't flicker
Test localization with long labels in German and French to confirm spinner and truncation rules
Validate prefers-reduced-motion: countdown uses color change not motion when enabled
